title: BrainQuake example SEEG data: ictal and interictal stereo-EEG from 8 epilepsy patients (Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital)
description: This dataset contains ictal and interictal stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 8 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, collected at the Epilepsy Center of Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital during pre-surgical monitoring. It is the example dataset of the BrainQuake toolbox for spatiotemporal SEEG analysis. Each patient has a 71-second seizure clip and an interictal segment of up to about 2 hours, sampled at 2000 Hz. The data are organized in iEEG-BIDS without signal processing.
methods_description: SEEG depth electrode recordings were acquired at 2000 Hz during about two weeks of pre-surgical monitoring. Pre-implant MRI and post-implant CT were acquired but are not redistributed. Ictal clips were exported for epileptogenicity index analysis and interictal segments for high-frequency event detection. EDF files are unchanged apart from removal of patient names from the EDF+ annotations.

funding_references.funder_name: National Key R&D Program of China
